en.bdb: The spiritual sport of the gursikh

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: param jot paragaas kar unaman liv laiee|

en.bdb: Kindling the supreme light in his mind a gurmukh remains absorbed in the state of supreme trance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਨਹਦਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: param tat paravaan kar anahadh dhun vaiee|

en.bdb: When he adopts the supreme reality (Lord) in his mind, the unstruck melody starts ringing.
Becoming conscious for altruism now resides in his heart the sense of God’s omnipresence.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਨਭਉ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes aves kar anabhau padh paiee|

en.bdb: Inspired by the teachings of the Guru, gurmukh attains the state of fearlessness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat kar saadhanaa ik man ik dhiaaiee|

en.bdb: Disciplining himself in the company in the holy ones i.e. losing his ego, he remembers Lord with single-minded devotion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਉ ਚੜ੍ਹਿ ਇਉਂ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit_en: veeh ikeeh chaRhaau chaReh iau(n) nij ghar jaiee ||5||

en.bdb: This way, entering from this world into the spiritual world, he finally establishes himself in his real nature.
